body: Built contrib/remote (own module, x/net/html): Cache (Get/Open/Purge/Sweep, LRU touch via SetModTime, per-instance single flight), LinkPreview (bounded page read, og:image through the SSRF guard, JSON stored with PreviewTTL), Proxy (signedurl HMAC, re-sniff, nosniff+CSP+cache headers). Keys are SHA-256 of the canonical URL. 27 tests, 15 guards break-verified. Guide docs/plugins/remote.md, README, examples/remote-media (own module). Sweep is scheduled via jobs.Func, no jobs/ change.
